messages:
Sam (AE): FYI EduCorp POC just surfaced: they want Private deployment + Dedicated GPUs. Asking for 35% off list + a 99.99% SLA for 12 months. Need approval path.
Maria S. (Sales Ops): %35 is pretty big. Do we have expected ARR / monthly commit numbers from them?
Sam (AE): Lina and I scoped infra: they want 4x A100 equiv dedicated, steady baseline with burst. Proposed commit is $180k/mo (12mo) -> $2.16M committed. They asked for 35% to match their internal vendor comps.
Lina (SE): Tech side: private deploy is fine in VPC. Will need additional ops runbook and a pre-approved maintenance window. Can do KMS integration and audit logs. Timeline ~6 weeks.
DealDeskBot: Approval request created: req-64290. Labels: finance-review, security-check, legal-review. Link: https://redwood.internal/approvals/req-64290
Joel - Finance: Need margin check. At 35% off, gross margin drops below our target for Dedicated. What's the suggested counter? Also confirm any credits/one-time setup waiver.
Sam (AE): They also asked to waive onboarding fees ($25k) and want a volume credit for tokens beyond the commit. I proposed we: 1) approve 25% max, 2) onboarding fee reduced to $10k, 3) token overage billed at committed rate + 10% uplift.
Maria S. (Sales Ops): Please post a quick P&L snippet. Finance needs NRR and contribution margin.
Joel - Finance: Quick calc:
```
List price: $240k/mo
Requested 35% -> net $156k/mo (lossy for us)
Counter 25% -> net $180k/mo -> annual $2.16M
Onboarding fee: waive -> -$25k hit now, or reduce to $10k -> -$10k
Estimated gross margin at 25% discount: ~38% (ok for Dedicated)
```
Joel - Finance: At 25% + $10k onboarding we can greenlight from finance, contingent on legal SLA terms and security sign-off.
Ava CISO: Confirming security: private deploy + KMS + audit logs acceptable, but we need contractual guarantees on incident response and data deletion. Also require data residency clause for EU if they process EU student data.
Lina (SE): We can commit to incident response SLA (4hr P1) and provide KMS + key rotation guidance. EU region deploy is available. No problem.
Maria S. (Sales Ops): Summary for deal desk: EduCorp commit $180k/mo for 12 months, approved discount 25%, onboarding fee $10k, SLA addendum (4hr P1 incident response), data residency + KMS clause. Approve to send term sheet to customer and route to Legal for contract language.
Sam (AE): Thanks — I'll update the term sheet and loop in Legal. @Joel - Finance can you confirm final approval so I can push?
Joel - Finance: Confirmed. Approve 25% discount under these terms. Final signoff after Legal adds SLA + data residency language. :white_check_mark:
Sam (AE): Great, sending updated term sheet now.
DealDeskBot: req-64290 status -> APPROVED_BY_FINANCE (25% cap). Next: legal-review.
Maria S. (Sales Ops): Tagging @Legal to draft amendment.
Ava CISO: I'll review the legal draft for security wording once available.
Sam (AE): Closing loop — thanks team! :tada:
